main_text.p: & quod uiuit plerumque nutriatur: exceptis ijs quae aliquandiu uiuunt, nec tamen nutriuntur: ut oua, femina nondum terrae mandata. Nihil autem attinet, de prodigiosa quorundam inedia, qualis fuit Nicolai eremitae Heluetij, qui multis annis à cibo citra simulatione abstinuit, hoc loco intempestiuè uerba facere.

Exiftimo Ariftotelem ideo dixiffe, Vitam esse conseruationem caloris natiui. Vt enim in lychno flamma alitur oleo aut cera iusta quantitate: ita uitalis spiritus rapit alimetum ex humido radicali, quod utcunque fouetur ab alimentari: quod cum impurius fit, senium accersit, illo paulatim deficiente.
Anima autem est id quo uiuimus, sentimus, mouemur & intelligimus: utin 2 de Anima docuit Ariftoteles.
Iam uero, cum quid vitae naturalis sit, breuiter dixerimus: cur ea homini pio & prudenti no sit afpernanda, nedum abijcienda, uideamus.
1. Ab efficiente principe. Nullum Dei donum, seu eximiu, seu mediocre homini religioso contemnendum est. Summa enim cum gratitudine ea dona amplecti, & ijs

page.notes: Page is a single text column. The numbered paragraph "1." is a paragraph opening with a number, so it is kept as a paragraph, not a heading. The Greek/Hebrew check: none present. Doubtful readings: "utin 2 de Anima" (the "2" may be a reference mark or printing error, possibly for a marginal reference); "nō" in "no sit" is printed as "nó" with a macron-like mark, read as "no"; "alimentari" and "dixiffe" read from print. Last line "& ijs" appears as a catchword-like trailing fragment, kept as text since it sits within the body. Some words in the upper left margin area are faint show-through and are excluded.
